talentIII.name: Unclaimed Victory
talentIII.description: When Kiva defeats a Forsaken target, she gains a Shield equal to 12% of her Max HP for 2 rounds, and 12% more for each Broken Link she is holding, up to 36%. All Broken Links are consumed.

basic.name: Faultline Tap
basic.description: Deals 155% Attack damage and applies Cracked for 2 rounds. Cracked reduces Block by 18%.

active.name: Demolition Right
active.description: Deals 340% Attack damage to the front enemy. If it is Cracked, removes Cracked and grants Branik a Shield equal to 34% Max HP for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Salvaged Cover
passive1.description: The first time each round a Cracked enemy attacks, Branik gains 12% Damage Reduction until round end.

basic.name: Notice of Loss
basic.description: Deals 180% Attack damage and applies Arrears for 2 rounds. At turn end, Arrears loses 4% current HP.

active.name: Compounding Sentence
active.description: Deals 360% Attack damage to enemies with Arrears and extends Arrears by 1 round, up to 3 rounds.

passive1.name: No Appeal
passive1.description: Enemies with Arrears receive 30% less healing; on defeat, their Arrears moves to the highest-HP enemy.

passives.name: Notice of Loss
passives.description: The Arrears tick: a body carrying it loses 4% of its current HP as its own turn ends, bounded at 105% of Demos's Attack. The bound is not in Pinoy's sentence and is the only thing holding the clause inside the band - see Docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md group 12.

basic.name: Commitment Cut
basic.description: Deals 120% Attack damage. If Kest attacked this target last turn, deals 35% additional Attack damage.

active.name: No Way Back
active.description: Deals 260% Attack damage to Kest’s last target. On defeat, attacks the lowest-HP enemy for 100% Attack damage.

passive1.name: Commit to the Return
passive1.description: Kest cannot change targets while his target lives, but deals 12% more damage to it and takes 10% less from it.

passives.name: No Way Back
passives.description: The follow-through on No Way Back only: an enemy defeated during that cast carries into the lowest-HP enemy.

basic.name: Measured Tap
basic.description: Deals 140% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 90% Attack.

active.name: Hard Remedy
active.description: Deals 240% Attack damage to all enemies, removes one debuff from each ally, and cleansed allies recover 15% missing HP.

passive1.name: Triage After Loss
passive1.description: The first time an ally falls below 35% HP, grant them a 22% Max HP Shield for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Rangefinder Bolt
basic.description: Deals 175% Attack damage to the highest-Attack enemy and applies Exposed Frequency for 2 rounds. Allied attacks ignore 14% Defense against it.

active.name: Cut the Wire
active.description: Deals 370% Attack damage to an enemy with Exposed Frequency, then transfers its buffs to the lowest-HP enemy for 1 round.

passive1.name: Dead Channel
passive1.description: When an enemy with Exposed Frequency gains a buff, Tavia deals 85% Attack damage to it once per round.

basic.name: Offered Strike
basic.description: Deals 150% Attack damage and gives the lowest-Energy ally 22 Energy.

active.name: Distribution
active.description: Deals 245% Attack damage to all enemies, then transfers the largest ally Shield to the lowest-HP ally and extends it 1 round.

passive1.name: Nothing Hoarded
passive1.description: At round start, Celen transfers 18 Energy from the highest-Energy ally to the lowest.

basic.name: Reclaimed Round
basic.description: Deals 165% Attack damage and applies Loose Parts for 2 rounds. The next ally to hit it gains 14 Energy.

active.name: Parts Exchange
active.description: Deals 295% Attack damage to enemies with Loose Parts, then moves Loose Parts to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Find a Use
passive1.description: When an ally gains Energy from Loose Parts, Mika gains a Shield equal to 45% Attack for 1 round.

passives.name: Reclaimed Round
passives.description: The Loose Parts payout itself: the first ally each round to strike a marked enemy takes 14 Energy off it.

basic.name: Crossing Cut
basic.description: Deals 145% Attack damage and gives the lowest-HP ally 20% of the HP they are missing, out of Rhys's own, if they are below 50% HP.

active.name: Change Sides
active.description: Deals 270% Attack damage and swaps Rhys’s buffs with the target’s debuffs for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Shared Peril
passive1.description: When an ally takes a hit exceeding 25% Max HP, Rhys takes 30% of it instead, once per round.

basic.name: Bad Omen
basic.description: Deals 105% Attack damage and changes one buff on the target into its matching debuff for 2 rounds.

active.name: Forecast Reversed
active.description: Deals 190% Attack damage to all enemies and reverses one Attack, Defense or Speed modifier on each.

passive1.name: Prediction Cost
passive1.description: Whenever Siofra changes a buff into a debuff, that target loses 10 Energy, once per round.

passives.name: Prediction Cost
passives.description: The same cost after Forecast Reversed: every enemy whose modifier was turned over loses 10 Energy.

basic.name: Wrong Turn
basic.description: Deals 290% Attack damage and applies Misdirected for 2 rounds. The first buff a Misdirected enemy gains each round goes to one of Vanno’s allies instead.

active.name: Road Not Taken
active.description: Deals 360% Attack damage to a Misdirected enemy and moves its debuffs to the highest-HP enemy for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Exit Unmarked
passive1.description: When a Misdirected enemy falls, Vanno cannot be targeted until his next turn.

passives.name: Wrong Turn
passives.description: The misdirection itself: a buff landing on a Misdirected enemy is taken off it and given to a random ally of Vanno’s, once per round.

basic.name: Measurement Strike
basic.description: Deals 210% Attack damage and applies Settling for 2 rounds. Settling reduces Speed by 8% each round, up to 24%.

active.name: Weight of Time
active.description: Deals 400% Attack damage to enemies with Settling. Targets at 24% Speed Down are Stunned for 1 round.

passive1.name: Load Bearing
passive1.description: When Settling expires, apply 15% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Reserve Swing
basic.description: Deals 60% Attack damage and grants Reserve for 2 rounds. Reserve reduces the next damage taken by 18%.

active.name: Open the Reserve
active.description: Deals 90% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Reserve to all allies for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Rationed Strength
passive1.description: When Reserve prevents damage, its holder recovers 4% Max HP, or gains 6 Energy if it is already whole.

basic.name: Holdfast Thrust
basic.description: Deals 145% Attack damage. If Jory was attacked since his last turn, he heals 4% Max HP.

active.name: Bar the Way
active.description: Deals 230% Attack damage and Taunts the front enemy for 2 rounds; it deals 15% less damage to Jory.

passive1.name: Worn Hinges
passive1.description: The first time each round an enemy hits Jory, he counterattacks it for 110% Attack damage.

basic.name: Returning Shot
basic.description: Deals 280% Attack damage; if the target attacked an ally since Maera's last turn, deals 70% additional Attack damage.

active.name: Keep the Beacon
active.description: Deals 540% Attack damage to the enemy that most recently damaged an ally. On defeat, allies recover 7% Max HP.

passive1.name: Watch the Water
passive1.description: The first time each ally falls below 45% HP, Maera’s next attack is a guaranteed Critical.

passives.name: Keep the Beacon
passives.description: The relief on Keep the Beacon only: an enemy defeated during that cast sends every ally 7% of their Max HP.

basic.name: Waking Touch
basic.description: Deals 130% Attack damage and heals the lowest-HP ally for 60% Attack.

active.name: Unfinished Rest
active.description: Deals 210% Attack damage to all enemies and gives the two lowest-HP allies Recovery for 3 rounds. Recovery heals 3% Max HP each turn.

passive1.name: Do Not Disturb
passive1.description: When an ally with Recovery would die, remove Recovery and leave them at 1 HP. Once per battle.

basic.name: Offbeat Chime
basic.description: Deals 105% of Attack damage to the enemy with the highest Energy and reduces that enemy's Energy by 10. If the target has more Energy than Dahlia, the lowest-HP ally is healed for 45% of Attack.

active.name: Scattered Choir
active.description: Deals 165% of Attack damage to all enemies and creates a Displaced state on the enemy with the highest Energy for 2 rounds. Displaced enemies cannot target the same ally twice in a row. Whenever a Displaced enemy attacks an ally, that ally gains 10 Energy and Dahlia heals them for 70% of Attack. If the Displaced enemy uses an Active Skill while Displaced, cancel the skill and remove Displaced.

talentI.name: Restless Chorus
talentI.description: Displaced lasts 1 additional round. The first time a Displaced enemy changes its attack target each round, that enemy also loses 10 Energy.

talentII.name: Shared Rhythm
talentII.description: Whenever Dahlia heals an ally through Broken Rhythm, the ally with the second-lowest HP is also healed for 40% of Attack.

talentIII.name: Final Cadence
talentIII.description: When Displaced ends without the enemy having its Active Skill canceled, Dahlia deals 120% of Attack damage to that enemy and immediately restores 20 Energy to the ally with the lowest Energy.

basic.name: Shove Aside
basic.description: Deals 150% Attack damage and shoves the target out of position if another enemy is alive.

active.name: Redeploy Cover
active.description: Deals 250% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Mobile Cover for 2 rounds; it reduces the first area hit each round by 20%.

passive1.name: Leave No Corner
passive1.description: When an ally with Mobile Cover is singled out, its turn progress advances by 12%.

basic.name: Ringing Slug
basic.description: Deals 230% Attack damage and applies Ringing for 2 rounds. A Ringing enemy loses 5 Energy whenever it casts an active skill.

active.name: No Quiet Moment
active.description: Deals 400% Attack damage to enemies with Ringing, cancels a cast in flight and takes 20 Energy off every Ringing enemy.

passive1.name: Aftershock Clock
passive1.description: At round end, Ringing enemies are delayed by 15% turn progress.

passives.name: Ringing Slug
passives.description: The toll itself: a Ringing enemy loses 5 Energy as it casts.

basic.name: Bad Entrance
basic.description: Deals 175% Attack damage and applies Flustered for 2 rounds, reducing Effect Hit by 15%.

active.name: Take the Floor
active.description: Deals 320% Attack damage to a Flustered enemy and forces its next attack onto Niko.

passive1.name: Ruin the Agenda
passive1.description: When a Flustered enemy attempts a debuff, Flustered is replaced by Silence for 1 round. Silence prevents active skills.

basic.name: Cut In
basic.description: Deals 130% Attack damage and advances Sable’s next turn by 10%. If Never Waiting is banked, deals 30% additional Attack damage and spends it.

active.name: Wrong Order
active.description: Deals 215% Attack damage to all enemies and delays the highest-Energy enemy by 25% turn progress.

passive1.name: Never Waiting
passive1.description: Whenever Sable delays an enemy, she gains 12 Energy and banks 30% Attack damage onto her next Basic Attack.

basic.name: Snag
basic.description: Deals 135% Attack damage and removes 6% turn progress for each target buff, up to 18%.

active.name: Pull the Seam
active.description: Deals 215% Attack damage to all enemies. Targets above 50% turn progress are delayed 20% and take 15% more Skill Damage for 2 rounds.

passive1.name: Unraveling Order
passive1.description: The first enemy delayed each round gains 10% Defense Down for 2 rounds.

basic.name: Strike the Line
basic.description: Deals 160% Attack damage, removes one buff from the target and applies 10% Effect Hit Down for 2 rounds.

active.name: Record Withheld
active.description: Deals 260% Attack damage to all enemies and applies Unlisted for 1 round. An Unlisted enemy loses 8 Energy instead of gaining it, once that round.

passive1.name: Missing Precedent
passive1.description: When an Unlisted enemy finishes casting an active skill, one of its buffs is struck from the record.

basic.name: Decoy Round
basic.description: Deals 120% Attack damage and applies False Lead for 2 rounds. The next single target skill aimed at Ruma lands on one of that enemy’s own allies instead, for 20% less damage.

active.name: Everyone Looks Here
active.description: Deals 170% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Ruma Concealed for 1 round. A Concealed unit cannot be targeted directly.

passive1.name: Spare Route
passive1.description: Whenever False Lead sends a blow somewhere else, Ruma gains 15 Energy.

basic.name: Lockstep
basic.description: Deals 240% Attack damage and applies Sealed for 2 rounds. A Sealed target cannot receive new buffs.

active.name: No Entry
active.description: Deals 410% Attack damage and Taunts the front enemy for 2 rounds. While Taunted it is Sealed.

passive1.name: Unasked Question
passive1.description: The first time each round a Sealed enemy strikes another ally, Toren gains a 15% Max HP Shield and redirects 25% of that hit.

basic.name: Catalogue Shot
basic.description: Deals 270% Attack damage and assigns Case Number for 2 rounds, listing the target for the whole line.

active.name: Close the Case
active.description: Deals 490% Attack damage to an enemy with Case Number. Damage increases 10% per displayed buff, up to 40%.

passive1.name: No Unfiled Death
passive1.description: When an enemy with Case Number falls, every ally gains 8 Energy and the highest-Attack enemy is listed in its place.

basic.name: Tested Touch
basic.description: Deals 130% Attack damage and removes one debuff from the lowest-HP ally.

active.name: Name the Wound
active.description: Deals 230% Attack damage to all enemies and grants Diagnosed for 2 rounds. Diagnosed allies receive 18% more healing.

passive1.name: Exact Treatment
passive1.description: When Lio removes a debuff, that ally recovers 5% of the HP it is missing and gains 10 Energy.

basic.name: Stamp of Entry
basic.description: Deals 310% Attack damage and applies Registered for 2 rounds.

active.name: Hold the Line
active.description: Deals 520% Attack damage and holds the target in place for 2 rounds, during which it takes 12% more damage from Nadine.

passive1.name: Proper Place
passive1.description: The first time each round a Registered enemy hides itself, Nadine strikes it for 110% Attack damage and strips the concealment.
